title: Convolution of probability measures
statement: Let $\phi$ and $\psi$ be probability densities on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. Sampling a point according to the probability measure associated with $\phi$, then independently sampling a point according to the measure associated with $\psi$, and adding the two points gives the probability measure associated with the convolution of $\phi$ and $\psi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\phi$ and $\psi$ are probability densities on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
